description: Agent skills for OPEM — Open-Source PEMFC Simulation Tool

skills.name: Select a PEMFC Model
skills.description: Choose the right OPEM fuel cell model for your simulation use case.

skills.name: Run a Static PEMFC Simulation
skills.description: Execute a static fuel cell analysis using Amphlett, Chamberline-Kim, or Larminie-Dicks models.

skills.name: Run a Dynamic PEMFC Simulation
skills.description: Execute a dynamic fuel cell analysis using Padulles, Padulles-Hauer, Padulles-Amphlett, or Chakraborty models.

skills.name: Interpret OPEM Results
skills.description: Understand output dictionaries, units, report files (.opem, .csv, .html), and overall parameters.

skills.name: Troubleshoot OPEM Errors
skills.description: Diagnose and fix common simulation errors including None outputs, warnings, and parameter issues.
